title: Synthesis and Verification of Register Automata over Data Sequences (Technical Report)
abstract: arXiv:2511.19100v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Data sequences, such as time series, traces, and sensor streams, are words over large or infinite data domains. Their properties often depend on comparisons between values at different positions, which finite automata cannot express directly. We study synthesis and verification for Deterministic Register Automata (DRAs) over ordered data sequences. DRAs combine finite control with registers for remembered data values, providing compact symbolic descriptions of quantitative sequence languages. Our technical core is a local-search synthesis procedure and an exact robustness checker for DRAs. We fix the alphabet theory to ordered rationals $(\Q;<,=)$ with rational guard constants and use non-negative affine accumulator costs. For a fixed number of DRA registers, the checker runs in polynomial time; its dependence on that number is exponential. It reduces robustness to coverability and then to a shortest-path problem. translated_title: 数据序列上寄存器自动机的合成与验证（技术报告）
translated_abstract: 数据序列，例如时间序列、轨迹和传感器流，是定义在大型或无限数据域上的词。它们的性质往往依赖于不同位置的值之间的比较，而有限自动机无法直接表达这种比较。我们研究了有序数据序列上确定性寄存器自动机（DRA）的合成与验证问题。DRA 将有限控制与用于记忆数据值的寄存器相结合，为量化序列语言提供了紧凑的符号化描述。我们的技术核心是针对 DRA 的局部搜索合成过程以及一个精确的鲁棒性检查器。我们将字母表理论固定为有序有理数 $(\Q;<,=)$，并使用有理数守卫常量与非负仿射累加器代价。对于固定数量的 DRA 寄存器，该检查器可在多项式时间内运行；但其对寄存器数量的依赖是指数级的。该方法将鲁棒性验证归约为可覆盖性问题，进而归约为最短路径问题。
tldr: 该论文提出了针对有序数据序列上确定性寄存器自动机的局部搜索合成方法与精确鲁棒性检查器，后者对固定寄存器数量可在多项式时间内运行，并通过将鲁棒性归约为可覆盖性和最短路径问题实现高效验证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a local-search synthesis procedure and an exact robustness checker for Deterministic Register Automata over ordered data sequences, which runs in polynomial time for a fixed number of registers by reducing robustness to coverability and shortest-path problems.
